summary: trivago N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the resumption of trading in its American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange's Open Market as of June 26, 2026. Trading had been suspended since November 2023 due to a missing settlement declaration from Clearstream following an ISIN change related to the ADS ratio change. Clearstream has now issued the declaration, restoring trading on German exchanges. The ADRs continue to trade on Nasdaq under symbol TRVG. This is an administrative update, not a special situation, with no deal terms, board recommendation, or strategic implications.
